title: Looking for a few design partners for an MCP quant research server
author: Vegetable-Rub-8241
selftext:
Building Lagias. MCP server your agent calls from Claude Code or Cursor.

You describe a strategy idea. It runs the research and the backtest. A separate scoring step the model cannot touch grades the result on data it never saw. Your agent stays in charge. We supply the factors, the math, and the referee. (What a LLM can't do by its nature)

Looking for a small number of design partners while it is still young. By invitation. Founders grant it by name, not a paid tier.

Everything in Free, plus:

\- current factor values on one universe

\- a direct line to us while we shape it

\- room to work like a customer for as long as the grant runs

Want people who already iterate and will say when it is wrong or slow.  
If that is you: [lagias.com](http://lagias.com) or DM me with what you already run and what you would plug this into. "Wrong for me" is a useful answer too.

comments.author: TilmanAmbach
comments.body:
Interesting architecture, especially keeping the scoring/validation layer separate from the LLM.

I'm working on a structured SEC ownership dataset and API around Forms 3, 4 and 5. One area I've been exploring is point-in-time research on insider activity — transaction date vs SEC acceptance time, open-market classification, insider roles, ownership changes, clusters, 10b5-1 plans, etc.

I'm curious whether alternative event datasets like that fit the kind of research Lagias is intended to support, or whether you're currently focused mainly on conventional market/fundamental factors.
